value.rationale: The number of representations is a central explicitly studied invariant for antipalindromic quotient sets. This theorem decides infinite multiplicity throughout the natural odd Mersenne family 4^r-1, a striking contrast to the exact finite multiplicity for adjacent 4^r+1 from the motivating paper. It is an infinite uniform constructive classification, not an arbitrary finite example or routine reparameterization.
